The '''14th Infantry''' was a unit of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The 14th was first encountered by [[Omega Squad]] during their deployment to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]]. When the [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos']] mission had been compromised, they requested evac from the [[85th Infantry]], also stationed on Haurgab. Failing to make contact, the team then contacted [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|ARC Captain]] [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for assistance which later arrived in the form of a 14th Infantry [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] from [[Neska]].

Troopers of the 14th would later join the 85th, as well as the assembled clone commando squads, in small numbers as part of the Haurgab [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]. The poor marksmanship of one of the troopers, combined with the earlier ignorance of [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] led to suspicions that the clones of the 14th were created on a world other than [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
